footer.tagline: Built for clarity. Designed for control.

login.heroBody: ExpenseIQ gives you a real-time view of every dollar you spend — by category, by month, by habit. Sign in to pick up right where you left off.
login.heroBullet1: Track spending across 7 smart categories — Food, Transport, Bills, and more
login.heroBullet2: Live budget alerts so you never blow past your monthly limit
login.heroBullet3: Beautiful charts that turn raw numbers into clear financial insight
login.formBody: Enter your email and password to access your ExpenseIQ dashboard.
login.formBullet1: Email — your registered email address, e.g. alex@example.com
login.formBullet3: Forgot your password? — request a reset link sent to your inbox
login.signupBody: Create a free account in under a minute — no credit card required.
login.errorEmailNotConfirmed: Please verify your email before logging in.
login.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

signup.heroHeading: Take control of every dollar you spend
signup.heroBody: ExpenseIQ gives you a real-time, intelligent view of your finances — track expenses by category, set monthly budgets, and spot overspending before it happens. Join thousands of users who finally know where their money goes.
signup.heroBullet1: Secured by Supabase Auth — your data stays yours
signup.heroBullet2: Live dashboard updates the moment you log an expense
signup.heroBullet3: Per-category budget limits with instant over-budget alerts
signup.heroBullet4: Works beautifully on mobile, tablet, and desktop
signup.formBody: Sign up in under 30 seconds — no credit card required. Your personal finance dashboard is ready the moment you confirm your email.
signup.loginBody: Welcome back — sign in to your ExpenseIQ dashboard and pick up right where you left off.
